errors.text: The proposed comparison uses a single-phase fcc alloy rather than the compositionally matched C14-dominant Fe27Co27Ni17Ti29 alloy needed to assign the 214 K transition and distinguish C14-specific behavior.

The antiferromagnetic interaction is localized primarily to an fcc/C14 interface, whereas the target mechanism concerns antiparallel coupling of Fe/Co/Ni and Ti contributions within the phase electronic structures, particularly the fcc phase.
The proposed interface DFT calculation does not directly provide the requested spin-polarized density of states of the bulk fcc phase at the Fermi level.
